label: Auth0
note: Auth0 CIAM platform. Guidance covers MFA, Attack Protection, token handling, and client-secret hygiene.

questions.label: MFA factors
questions.text: Which MFA factors are enabled? (select all that apply)

guidance.text: **Strong posture.** WebAuthn / passkeys are phishing-resistant. Consider Adaptive MFA to step up only on risk signals, reducing friction.
**Good.** TOTP is a solid factor. For phishing resistance on sensitive apps, add WebAuthn / passkeys and enable Adaptive MFA for risk-based step-up.
**Review.** Push is convenient but susceptible to MFA-fatigue (prompt bombing). Enable number-matching where available and prefer WebAuthn for high-value access.
**Review.** Auth0 recommends replacing SMS/voice with OTP or WebAuthn to mitigate SIM-swap and SMS-pumping/toll-fraud. If SMS is kept, enable provider-side fraud protection.
**Review.** Auth0 recommends replacing SMS/voice with OTP or WebAuthn to mitigate toll fraud and interception.
**GAP.** MFA is disabled. Enable MFA and consider Adaptive MFA to trigger step-up on new devices, IP reputation, or impossible-travel signals.

questions.label: Attack Protection
questions.text: Are Auth0 Attack Protection features enabled (Brute-force Protection, Suspicious IP Throttling, Breached Password Detection, Bot Detection)?

guidance.text: **GAP.** Enable Attack Protection. Brute-force Protection, Suspicious IP Throttling, Breached Password Detection, and Bot Detection are the core defenses against credential-stuffing and account takeover, and apply with minimal user friction.

**Review.** Turn on the remaining Attack Protection features, especially Breached Password Detection (blocks known-leaked credentials) and Bot Detection (CAPTCHA on suspected bot traffic). Cover every entry point: Universal Login, custom pages, passwordless, native apps, and APIs.
**Good.** Core Attack Protection is active. Stream Auth0 logs to your SIEM and alert on credential-stuffing and signup-fraud spikes.

options.label: Rotation enabled, with absolute / inactivity expiration

guidance.text: **Review.** Enable refresh-token rotation and set absolute plus inactivity expiration. Rotation lets Auth0 detect and revoke reused (stolen) tokens; long-lived static refresh tokens widen the account-takeover window. Keep session and token lifetimes proportionate to the app's risk.
**Good.** Refresh-token rotation with bounded expiration supports reuse detection. Confirm lifetimes match the product's sensitivity.
**Good.** No long-lived refresh tokens. Confirm session lifetimes are proportionate to sensitivity.

questions.label: Client secrets
questions.text: How are client secrets handled for SPAs / native apps?

options.label: Public app with PKCE, no secret
Confidential app, secret kept server-side only
Client secret present in SPA / native app

guidance.text: **GAP.** Never expose client secrets in SPAs or native apps. Use a public application type with the Authorization Code flow plus PKCE; keep secrets in backend environment variables only.
**Good.** Public app with PKCE, or a confidential app whose secret stays server-side. Also validate JWT signature (JWKS), issuer, audience, and expiry on every token.
